tagName.en-US: Tag name of the root element.

hasSider.zh-CN: 表示子元素里有 Sider。直接子节点中的 Sider 会自动识别；嵌套更深的 Sider 在挂载后才登记，服务端渲染时传 true 可避免样式闪动。传 false 不能去掉 Sider 带来的 has-sider 类。
hasSider.en-US: Indicates that a Sider is inside. A Sider among the direct children is detected automatically; a deeper one registers after mount, so pass true during server rendering to avoid style flashing. Passing false cannot remove the has-sider class that a Sider adds.

children.zh-CN: Layout 的内容，可放 LayoutHeader、LayoutSider、LayoutContent、LayoutFooter 或嵌套的 Layout。
children.en-US: Content of the Layout: LayoutHeader, LayoutSider, LayoutContent, LayoutFooter or a nested Layout.

tagName.en-US: Tag name of the root element.

type.zh-CN: 内部使用，决定类名后缀。
type.en-US: For internal use; decides the class name suffix.

tagName.en-US: Tag name of the root element.

type.zh-CN: 内部使用，决定类名后缀。
type.en-US: For internal use; decides the class name suffix.

type.zh-CN: 内部使用，决定类名后缀。

breakpoint.zh-CN: 触发响应式布局的断点，可选 xs、sm、md、lg、xl、xxl。仅在挂载时读取一次。
breakpoint.en-US: Breakpoints that trigger the responsive layout: xs, sm, md, lg, xl or xxl. Read once at mount.

onBreakpoint.zh-CN: 挂载时对 breakpoint 中的每个断点按当前视口调用一次，之后在命中或离开时调用，参数为断点名与是否命中。
onBreakpoint.en-US: Called once at mount for each screen listed in breakpoint with the current viewport state, then whenever it starts or stops matching, with the screen name and whether it matches.
